text:
jamie_product: quick sync — we need to finalize the streaming finish semantics for chat/completions. customers are asking for unambiguous finish reasons, structured deltas for function calls, and a clear mobile resume story. can we align on launch criteria?

ana_devex: +1. mobile teams pushed back on heavyweight JSON per-token. proxies/timeouts make SSE attractive for mobile. also some customers want explicit "final" vs "partial" markers. :iphone:

mike_infra: SSE is easier for HTTP proxies/ingress, but websockets give us multiplexing and binary framing for small delta envelopes. cost/ops tradeoff: WS needs sticky connections and different autoscaling.

samantha_research: from an eval perspective we want a stable finish_reason taxonomy: e.g. "complete", "max_tokens", "stop_sequence", "function_call_complete", "cancelled", "error". consumers (especially rerank/chain systems) rely on that.

luis_mobile: mobile note — when app backgrounded, connection may drop. resume token + prefix-kv restore is required. SSE reconnects are simpler but some mobile proxies drop long SSE streams. we need client SDK patterns.

jamie_product: proposed minimum viable contract: 1) delta envelope with small header + payload (keep it ascii), 2) explicit "type" field for chunk kinds (token, metadata, function_chunk, finish), 3) finish event always emitted with standardized finish_reason. fallback: if transport disconnects, send a special "resumable_checkpoint" chunk every ~2s.

mike_infra: sketch of envelope (short):

```
{type: "token", seq: 123, content: "hello"}
{type: "function_chunk", fd: "call_id", seq: 1, part: "{\"arg\": ...}"}
{type: "finish", reason: "stop_sequence", code: 0}
```

Keep lines newline-delimited to play well with SSE. For WS we can send same JSON frames or a compact binary variant later.

ana_devex: +1 to the checkpoint idea. customers worry about partial-structured outputs — if a function call is interrupted we need to indicate whether the function invocation is committed or partial. suggest finish.reason values include "function_incomplete" vs "function_committed".

samantha_research: also add "finish.meta" optional object with model_version and prompt_checksum so we can correlate regressions. this should be tiny (ids only).

luis_mobile: can we make checkpoint payload tiny, like a one-line opaque resume token? mobile can't afford big reconnect handshakes.

mike_infra: yes — checkpoint = {type: "checkpoint", token: "base64...", cursor_seq: 124}. Keep payload <= 512 bytes.

jamie_product: launch criteria proposal (must pass before GA):
- docs + SDK examples for SSE and WS (web + mobile)
- telemetry: finish_reason present in >= 99% of streams; resume success rate >= 95% under simulated mobile disconnects
- latency: no added median p99 token latency > 10ms vs non-streaming baseline for same model under canary load
- fallback: when streaming not available, non-streaming completion must be served with identical finish_reason semantics

nana_devex: i'd add: structured function outputs must be reconstructable from deltas with <=1s reassembly time in client SDKs. provide reference client code.

samantha_research: QA gating: create prompt set with edge cases — long function calls, multi-stop-token sequences, nested function_call + text — and assert consistent finish_reason labeling and full reassembly.

jamie_product: ops question: what do we do for older SDKs/clients that expect plain text streaming? do we send both token text events and structured function_chunk events in parallel?

mike_infra: recommendation: always emit token events for backward compatibility (type: "token", content: "text") and also emit function_chunk events for clients that parse structured outputs. that'll double-sent tokens in the stream but keeps clients compatible. can gate behind model flag if cost/scale is an issue.

luis_mobile: duplicating tokens is painful on mobile data. can we add a header negotiation: clients send preferred modes: ["text_only", "structured_only", "both"]. server honors when possible, otherwise falls back to "both" for compatibility.

jamie_product: agreed — add handshake param. if no handshake present, default to "both" for a deprecation window. timeline: beta with both for 4 weeks, then encourage structured_only.

samantha_research: telemetry we need: per-route finish_reason distribution, fraction of streams using resume token, fraction of function calls with "committed" vs "incomplete". add regression alerts if function_committed drops.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for staging at 2026-05-03T17:00Z (canary id: stream-finish-2026-05).

jamie_product: next steps: 1) eng-runtime to PR delta envelope + checkpoint support (mike), 2) client SDK authors to add handshake + resume examples (ana + luis), 3) research to produce edge-case prompt set (samantha). aim for staging canary next week and the telemetry gating above. any blockers?

mike_infra: will start PR. need decision on default "both" window duration (4w ok) and checkpoint frequency (every 2s or >=512 token intervals).

ana_devex: 4w ok. checkpoint freq: every 2s or 256 tokens, whichever first. keeps token overhead predictable.

jamie_product: great — locking that in. thanks all, will follow up with a spec doc and example payloads. :thumbsup:
